_comment: Recorded from live Gerrit 3.10.9 and 3.8.9 dev sites on 2026-10-22 (see DOCUMENTATION.md, Verified against live instances). Unsuffixed entries are 3.10.9, `_3_8` entries 3.8.9. Scrubbed: the origin is https://gerrit.example.com, change numbers are renumbered to the scenario (30, 41, 42, 43, 57), account ids to 1000096 (alice), 1000097 (bob), 1000098 (carol), commit time zones to UTC. Scenario: project platform/app, change 42 on master (three patchsets, topic login, hashtag ui, bob Code-Review+1 with an inline comment, carol Verified+1) carries the Change-Id below; 57 is its cherry-pick to stable-1.0 and 30 an abandoned upload on release-0.9 (Gerrit refuses a new change for a Change-Id closed on the same branch); 41 <- 42 <- 43 is a relation chain. Bodies are stored as JSON; fake-fetch.js puts the )]}' line in front of every JSON answer, as Gerrit does. `patch` and `fileContent` are the base64 text Gerrit answers to Accept: text/plain. `errors` keep refusals with their status and body as sent (and the content type when it is JSON). `accountSelfWithoutUsername` is the one hand-made entry: accountSelf without its username.
